facts.value: Allocates an HSD_FogAdj and passes it to HSD_FogAdjInit. A descriptor supplies width and center plus only the first 48 bytes of its Mtx44 through PSMTXCopy. A null descriptor selects viewport-based width/center and a complete identity matrix. Returns the allocated object.
facts.rationale: Avoid implying a full descriptor Mtx44 copy.

evidence.why: Avoid implying a full descriptor Mtx44 copy.
Initializer distinguishes descriptor and default branches.
Six paired-single loads/stores cover offsets 0 through 47 only; no fourth-row copy.

facts.value: Successful allocation is asserted before initialization. With a descriptor, initialization writes width, center and the first three matrix rows, leaving the fourth row untouched by this routine. With no descriptor, viewport defaults and a complete identity matrix are written. No claim is made about allocation-time contents of untouched fields.
facts.rationale: The inherited fully initialized descriptor-matrix claim exceeds the copy extent.

evidence.why: The inherited fully initialized descriptor-matrix claim exceeds the copy extent.
Only default branch explicitly writes row 3.
Six paired-single loads/stores cover offsets 0 through 47 only; no fourth-row copy.

facts.value: Requests fog animation at frame by forwarding mask 0x7FF to HSD_FogReqAnimByFlags. The callee tests only 0x200 and makes one request on fog->aobj; the bits do not select individual fog properties.
facts.rationale: Distinguish animation-category selection from per-property channels.

evidence.why: Distinguish animation-category selection from per-property channels.
Only one mask bit is tested.
The request sets curr_frame and flags, then requests every FObj channel.

facts.value: Canonical signature void HSD_Fog_8037DE7C(HSD_Fog* fog, HSD_AObjDesc* desc). Fog is nullable; desc is passed to the loader, which returns NULL for a null descriptor. HSD_FogAddAnim is an inferred alias, not the source-defined function name.
facts.rationale: Keep the canonical signature separate from a comment-supported naming hypothesis.

A null descriptor yields NULL; non-null loads a controller.

facts.value: For a present fog_adj, calls ref_DEC. That helper returns true immediately for HSD_OBJ_NOREF, otherwise decrements and returns whether the old count was zero. On true, calls adjustment release and destroy; then passes aobj to HSD_AObjRemove and fog to the parent release method.
facts.rationale: Document the exact reference helper convention rather than assuming an ordinary count reaching zero.

evidence.why: Document the exact reference helper convention rather than assuming an ordinary count reaching zero.
ref_DEC returns true for HSD_OBJ_NOREF, or post-decrements and tests whether the old count was zero.

facts.value: Adjustment handling precedes AObj removal and parent release. An absent adjustment is skipped. The virtual adjustment release/destroy branch follows ref_DEC true, including the HSD_OBJ_NOREF sentinel case; pointer fields are not cleared here.
